pages.title: Rite of Severance
pages.text: The $(l)Rite of Severance$() removes the Oath for good. It destroys your $(item)Oathbound Relic$() and cleanses the brand.

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: You must have the $(item)Oathbound Relic$() equipped.$(br2)The altar needs:$(li)1 Oblivion Stone$(li)4 Echo Shards$(li)4 Crying Obsidian$(li)16 Soul Soil$(br2)You can only start it $(thing)at night$() or in $(thing)The End$().

pages.title: The Rite
pages.text: The rite lasts $(thing)30 seconds$(). Stay within $(thing)7 blocks$() of the altar.$(br2)During the rite, the altar keeps hitting you with the Oath's curses: fire, weakness, hunger, darkness, broken armor, and angry nearby mobs.

pages.title: Result
pages.text: Survive, and the Relic is destroyed, the brand is removed, and you get $(item)Fractured Relic Ash$().$(br2)The rite fails if you leave the area, die, lose the Relic, or the altar is broken.
